## About
J & C Import Car Care is a family owned shop at 5810 Lankershim Blvd in North Hollywood. Paul Geddie is the owner and service manager, Katrina handles the bookkeeping, Mariah runs the office, and Nathan is following in Paul's footsteps.
We can do everything except body work, from routine maintenance to adding some extra horsepower. One reviewer who moved out of state still brings his Honda van back to us, and another customer pointed out that an Enterprise is a few blocks down the street if you need a ride while your car is here.

## Services
- Routine maintenance: Major and minor services, including oil and filter changes, fluid and brake checks, and a general car inspection.
- Air conditioning services: Car blowing hot air, or no air at all? We can get your A/C working again.
- Brakes: Drums, shoes, pads, calipers, hoses, the master brake cylinder and more. That squeak when you stop too.
- Battery, starter and alternator: Battery, starter, alternator and ignition work to keep your car running smoothly.
- Installing turbos: Looking to add some extra horsepower? We install turbos right here in the shop.

## FAQ
Q: Do you do body work?
A: No. We handle everything except body work.

Q: Do estimates cost anything?
A: No, all estimates are free, and most are available over the phone.

Q: Do first time customers get anything off?
A: Yes. First time customers receive 10% off, up to $100 off the total bill.

I've never had an issue with any of the work he's done. When I've sold my previous cars or returned a leased Civic back to the dealership, there were never any problems.

What I've always appreciated most about Paul is that he's fair and honest. If something doesn't need to be fixed, he'll tell you. He's never been the type of mechanic who tries to convince you that you need work done when you don't.

There have also been plenty of times when I've had a long list of things that needed attention but was working with a budget. Paul will tell me what's important to take care of now, what I should plan for soon, and what can safely wait.
